name: midgard-node
description: A CLI application for submitting/receiving L2 transactions and committing/merging Midgard blocks

scripts.prebuild: pnpm --dir ../lucid-midgard run build && pnpm --dir ../midgard-sdk run build
scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --minify --format esm && tsup src/workers/* --minify --format esm
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir ../lucid-midgard run build && pnpm --dir ../midgard-sdk run build && tsc --noEmit
scripts.listen: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js listen
scripts.register-active-operator: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js register-active-operator
scripts.submit:l2-transfer: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js submit-l2-transfer
scripts.audit:blocks-immutable: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js audit-blocks-immutable
scripts.sweep-reference-script-wallet: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js sweep-reference-script-wallet
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js db:migrate
scripts.db:status: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js db:status
scripts.db:verify: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js db:verify
scripts.db:checksum: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js db:checksum
scripts.init: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js init
scripts.bench:codec: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && export BENCH_QUICK=1 && vitest run --config vitest.bench.config.ts tests/benchmarks/midgard-tx-codec.bench.ts --disable-console-intercept
scripts.bench:codec:quick: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && export BENCH_QUICK=1 && vitest run --config vitest.bench.config.ts tests/benchmarks/midgard-tx-codec.bench.ts --disable-console-intercept
scripts.bench:phase-a:native: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && export BENCH_QUICK=1 && vitest run --config vitest.bench.config.ts tests/benchmarks/native-phase-a.bench.ts --disable-console-intercept
scripts.bench:phase-a:native:quick: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && export BENCH_QUICK=1 && vitest run --config vitest.bench.config.ts tests/benchmarks/native-phase-a.bench.ts --disable-console-intercept
scripts.bench:phase-a:native:full: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && vitest run --config vitest.bench.config.ts tests/benchmarks/native-phase-a.bench.ts --disable-console-intercept
scripts.bench:validation: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && export BENCH_QUICK=1 && vitest run --config vitest.bench.config.ts tests/benchmarks/validation-benchmark.bench.ts --disable-console-intercept
scripts.bench:validation:quick: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && export BENCH_QUICK=1 && vitest run --config vitest.bench.config.ts tests/benchmarks/validation-benchmark.bench.ts --disable-console-intercept
scripts.bench:l2:e2e: STRESS_MODE=find-max STRESS_WAIT_FOR_COMMIT=true STRESS_WAIT_FOR_MERGE=true STRESS_CLIENT_SELF_CHECK_REQUIRED=true node scripts/throughput-valid-stress.mjs
scripts.test:operator-lifecycle:emulator: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && vitest run tests/commit-redeemers.test.ts tests/operator-lifecycle-emulator.test.ts --reporter=basic --disable-console-intercept
scripts.test:operator-lifecycle: pnpm run test:operator-lifecycle:emulator && pnpm run test:operator-lifecycle:preprod
scripts.test:tx-prep:node: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && vitest run tests/transactions-utils.test.ts tests/prepare-hub-oracle-nonce.test.ts tests/reference-scripts.test.ts tests/scheduler-refresh.test.ts tests/commit-end-time.test.ts tests/commit-block-planner.test.ts tests/da-payload.test.ts tests/e2e-da-gates.test.ts tests/e2e-service-supervisor.test.ts tests/e2e-runner.test.ts tests/e2e-summary.test.ts --reporter=basic --disable-console-intercept
scripts.test:tx-prep:emulator: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && vitest run tests/initialization-emulator.test.ts tests/operator-lifecycle-emulator.test.ts tests/deposit-flow-emulator.test.ts tests/reserve-payout-builders.test.ts --reporter=basic --disable-console-intercept
scripts.test:e2e-reliability: export NODE_ENV='emulator' && vitest run tests/transactions-utils.test.ts tests/commit-end-time.test.ts tests/scheduler-refresh.test.ts tests/da-payload.test.ts tests/e2e-da-gates.test.ts tests/e2e-service-supervisor.test.ts tests/e2e-runner.test.ts tests/e2e-summary.test.ts --reporter=basic --disable-console-intercept
